set.body: Compare PDist Euclidean/correlation, target similarity, exact leave-one-run-out memberships and source-keyed OOF reconstruction, a formula-matched standardized nearest-centroid classifier, conditionally comparable LDA predictions, fold-local standardization leakage traps, and fixed searchlight memberships/results. Raw score parity is claimed only for a matched learner definition.
set.title: C4: reproduce PyMVPA PDist, NFold, classification, and searchlight behavior
